plugins.name: session-successor
plugins.description: When a session runs low on context it writes a handoff and starts its successor; the companion JetBrains plugin, Session Successor on JetBrains Marketplace (https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/35944-session-successor), opens it in a new terminal tab.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A compact status line: model and effort, project, git branch, colour-coded context left, session and weekly usage limits with reset times, and an hourly phrase. Pure bash. After installing, run /statusline:setup once to switch it on.

plugins.name: spike
plugins.description: Spike rules in every session and subagent: Claude settles forks with evidence and keeps going, looks for an existing solution before writing a helper, and stops only when no spike can settle a fork or for product, scope or irreversible calls. /spike <question> runs the full method. Works best with Firecrawl and Context7.
